summary: Rebuilt both homepage featured perfume carousels as responsive liquid-glass 3D coverflows.
features: Both New to Scentory and Best Selling use the same overlapping 3D coverflow layout.
The active center card is larger, elevated and centered; side cards recede with perspective and scale.
Liquid-glass styling includes translucent layered surfaces, highlights, animated sheen and multi-layer shadows on every card.
Responsive card sizing for mobile, tablet and desktop.
Arrow controls, touch/pointer swipe, keyboard navigation and non-numbered pagination dots.
Removed numeric rank labels from Best Selling cards.
Preserved automatic newest-12 selection, the configured 12 best-selling product order, current product data, prices and links.
incremental_archive_policy: The V66 update ZIP contains only the five runtime files changed or added in this release plus this release manifest and README. It does not include historical update files.
